name: svn-control-center
description: Local web control center for managing SVN branches, dry-run test merges, interactive conflict resolution, and commits

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm.cmd --prefix server run dev" "npm.cmd --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm.cmd --prefix server run build && npm.cmd --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm.cmd --prefix server run typecheck && npm.cmd --prefix client run typecheck
